title: fix(i18n): translate the audit action labels and AI settings help still shown in English under translated locales
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9F4WDtjFVxtaSuW8CRqzebQ)_

Fixes #33834

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：中文等 10 种语言下，审计日志里 5 个动作名（含「Credential Use」）和 AI 设置页「会话标题」开关的说明不再显示英文；顺带补了 DashScope、Cloudflare 两个模型说明。
- **为什么改**：这些文案只有英文占位，System Overview 的「按动作统计」图表、审计列表和 AI 设置页在中文界面里夹着英文。
- **风险与回滚**：只改翻译值和两个包的测试，不加不删任何设置、键或审计动作；回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`plugin-audit/src/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`（5 个动作名）、`service-settings/src/translations/zh-CN.ts`（会话标题说明）、`settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`（设置页 help 纳入覆盖检查）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/translations/settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`，预期 150 项全绿；切到中文打开 设置 > AI，「会话标题」开关下是中文说明。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Audit action labels (plugin-audit).** `sys_audit_log.action` options `package_unmanaged_import`, `credential_use`, `scim_refused`, `audit_signing_key_change` and `dataset_query` were still the English extract fill in all ten translated locales (zh-CN, zh-Hant, ja-JP, ko, es-ES, fr, de, pt-BR, ru, ar). They are translated by hand in each `LOCALE.objects.generated.ts` (translated-locale values are hand-written per AGENTS.md's Documentation Guardrails row), and `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` then dropped their 50 entries from the `LOCALE.source-hashes.generated.ts` companions by itself (the companion lists only leaves that are still byte copies of the source). No other bundle in the nine-package set changed. The whole enum was swept: the only other English-equal labels are fr/de `import` / `export`, whose spelling in those languages is the English word; they stay, and the pin lists them by name.

**AI settings help (service-settings).** `settings.ai.keys.title_generation_enabled` had a `label` and no `help` in every locale, so the paragraph under the 会话标题 toggle rendered from the manifest description in English. It now has `help` in all ten locales. Holding field help to coverage (below) found three more on the same page, translated in this PR under the bounded same-class fix: `dashscope_model` and `cloudflare_model` (all ten locales) and `openrouter_api_key` (zh-CN only; every other locale already had it).

**Source untouched.** The source label and the manifest are untouched; no generator needed a new key.

## Why the existing checks missed these

- `check:i18n` compares key sets: a placeholder fill has the key, so it is in sync.
- `check:i18n-coverage` counts a present leaf as translated (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts`, `if (value !== undefined) translated += 1`); plugin-audit's baseline is 0 under that definition.
- `check:i18n-stale-fill` detects a copy of a PREVIOUS source revision; a copy of the CURRENT source has no second witness. The source-hash companion records exactly these copies, but nothing grades it: `withSourceFallback` serves the source text for them, which is English.
- service-settings' `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` held namespace/group/key labels, banners, actions and map headers to full coverage, but not a field's `help`.

Widening the CLI coverage counter to treat "equal to the source" as untranslated is not narrow: brand names, codes and same-spelling words (fr/de `Import`) are legitimately equal, and it would move the baseline of every example config. So the extensions are per family:

- **audit**: `audit-action-labels-translated.test.ts` judges what `AuditTranslations` serves for every `sys_audit_log.action` option in every translated locale and reds on a label equal to its English source (named same-spelling exceptions only). A sixth action added writer-first without translations reds here.
- **settings**: `missingFor` now also requires `keys.KEY.help` for each field that declares a `description`. Five `access_policy` helps are untranslated in every locale today; they sit in a shrink-only `HELP_OWED` list (with a test that reds while an entry no longer needs to be there) and are owed by #34121 rather than translated here.

## Tests

- New `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/translations/audit-action-labels-translated.test.ts` (12 tests): zh-CN `credential_use` is CJK and not `Credential Use`; each of the ten locales serves no action label equal to its source.
- Extended `packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` (not a forced edit; the card asked for the extension): field `help` coverage, the `HELP_OWED` staleness test, and a top-level `describe` pinning `settings.ai` `title_generation_enabled` help (zh-CN CJK and not the source; every locale has its own copy). 150 tests.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, blob restored to HEAD):

1. zh-CN `credential_use: "凭据使用"` → `"Credential Use"`: 2 failed / 10 passed (the zh-CN pin and the zh-CN sweep).
2. zh-CN title help removed: 3 failed / 147 passed (zh-CN `settings.ai` coverage, the zh-CN pin, the zh-CN per-locale copy test).
3. ja-JP `dashscope_model` help removed: 1 failed / 149 passed (`ja-JP missing for ai: key:dashscope_model.help`), proving the coverage extension catches a new untranslated help.

Package runs and gates, on head `ad576bc6` (after merging `origin/main`), full `./packages/**` build under the verify lock first (VERDICT command-exit 0):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test`: 95 files / 1553 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test`: 75 files / 1477 tests passed. Both packages' `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 66 families; all 66 exit 0. `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (its pinned positive-control commit was missing from the shallow clone); after `git fetch --depth=1 origin` of that commit it exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived zero).
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` regenerated the nine bundle sets; only the ten plugin-audit companions changed (50 entries removed).

## Acceptance notes

- `settings.access_policy` field help is English in all ten locales for `allowed_ip_ranges`, `session_idle_timeout_minutes`, `session_absolute_max_hours`, `max_concurrent_sessions_per_user` and `mfa_required` (Setup > Access policy renders the manifest description). Held in `HELP_OWED`; owed by #34121, filed by the seat (long security-policy prose in ten languages, outside this card's two strings).
- plugin-audit's zh-CN companion still lists 91 leaves that are byte copies of the English source (`sys_audit_checkpoint` 41, `sys_audit_amendment` 31, `sys_audit_signing_key` 15, `sys_activity` 4; ja-JP 102, es-ES 104). Outside the action enum this card sweeps; no public door measured here.
- The zh-CN `settings.ai` neighbours use half-width `,` `:` `(` inside Chinese text; the new zh-CN strings use full-width marks, which the file's own `settings.auth` rule names as correct. The rule is not extended to `settings.ai` here.

## Verification

Dedupe words: untranslated help, settings help coverage, access_policy help, audit English fill, source-hashes byte copy.
